tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a pending or partially-filled order.

tools.name: create_account
tools.description:
Open a new paper account for the authenticated user.

Use this when the user has no account yet (check with list_accounts first).
Accounts start with the deployment's default starting balance when
starting_balance is omitted.

tools.name: create_strategy
tools.description: Create a strategy from a spec.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific account.

tools.name: get_bars
tools.description: Get historical OHLCV bars for a symbol, oldest-first.

tools.name: get_strategy_run
tools.description: Get a strategy run's status, stats, and equity curve.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all accounts for the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: List orders for an account, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: list_positions
tools.description: List open positions for an account with quantity, average cost, and P&L.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: List all strategies for the authenticated user.

tools.name: list_strategy_runs
tools.description: List strategy runs (execution history), optionally filtered.

tools.name: list_strategy_templates
tools.description:
List the built-in strategy templates with their parameter JSON Schemas.

Use these to build a template-track strategy spec:
{"kind": "template", "template": <id>, "symbol": "AAPL", "params": {...}}.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Place a new paper trading order (MARKET, LIMIT, STOP, or STOP_LIMIT).

tools.name: run_backtest
tools.description:
Start a backtest of a strategy over a daily-bar window.

The backtest runs in the background; poll get_strategy_run(run_id) until
status is COMPLETED (stats + equity curve) or FAILED (error message).

tools.name: search_instruments
tools.description: Search the tradable instrument universe by symbol or company name.

tools.name: start_strategy
tools.description:
Start a live paper run of a strategy against a paper account.

The strategy's signals are evaluated on each new daily bar and turned
into orders on the account. Poll get_strategy_run for status
(STARTING -> RUNNING; ERROR on failure).

tools.name: stop_strategy
tools.description:
Stop a live paper run. Cancels the run's resting LIMIT orders but never
closes its positions.

tools.name: update_strategy
tools.description:
Update a strategy. Changing the spec bumps its version; name/description
edits do not.
